# Native action support and explicit begin frontier

This closes real `B9390` object/parent update marking, the required
`E8F10` interruption families `1C/1D/1F/20` including actual empty `8FDB0`,
and `1EFA70`/`1EEC30` local-player action notification. These are required
dependencies of `E8E10`/`E8E50`/`ED110`; the action begin remains unowned.
No action acknowledgement or behavior result is manufactured.

Marking preserves the initial flag read before the NONE guard, repeated
header-row access, and writes every ancestor even when its bit is already
set. Interruption reads the actual signed unit component offset and
descriptor callback, executes the genuine empty callback when selected,
and clears the real retained action bit. Other callback identities stop
at the exact unclosed call frontier. Notification admits the actual local
player, uses signed oldest-of-four selection with earliest ties, then
publishes tick, type WORD and zero-extended result WORD. Type/result are
real caller inputs, read lazily after the corresponding preceding stores.

The runtime's complete authored action catalog is already owned by
`native_tu15_world_memory.cpp` through `OriginalData::native_tu15()`.
Callback identities are metadata selecting native behavior; they are never
executed as guest pointers. Existing `unit_action_dispatch.cpp` supplies
related typed span/provider semantics; this SourceMemory boundary also
preserves the original lazy field, argument and fault order.

The independent reference executes unchanged English Xbox TU1.5 SHA256
`21b207e7efdacaf6124a0822837f8be570766a42505057f7fd2d2ba8f409c4fd`.
Physical i386 verifies complete 73728-byte declared banks and FP status;
Unicorn records source reads/stores and actual empty-callback ordering.
Controls cover parent chains and premarked ancestors, the initial NONE
read, positive/negative component offsets, all required selectors, real
callback execution, unqualified callback prefixes, signed local-user and
timestamp extremes, absent local admission, earliest ties, and low-word/
low-byte input consumption. Every selected memory/input fault prefix has
an independent physical partial-state hash.

The production admission predicate reads only retained EDI for the
interrupt selector. It receives no SourceMemory and performs no source
peek. The exact admission-plus-run path is tested for all qualified whole
and fault cases, including RET read faults; unsupported profiles are
explicitly unowned and make no state/result change. Direct-kernel controls
also verify the genuine unsupported callback frontier. The normal native
ABI consumes actual register/stack inputs and caller return words without
rebuilding dead volatile CPU scratch. Read-only activity is diagnostic.

GCC, Clang and instrumented ASan/UBSan compile the production module.
Private mutations skip marked ancestors, change earliest ties to latest,
or read the notification input too early; each must fail the original
reference. Only the required JSON and bounded reports/source hashes are
retained. Original ELFs, raw banks, native binaries and mutants are
disposable. A separate original repeat must reproduce canonical bytes.

Open begin dependencies are recorded in `original-action-frontier.json`:
`ED060` authored animation and parent/seat transitions, nested requests
through `D0520`/`D37F0`, and successful `ED110` speech selection through
`1C4600`/`213D30`. Full `E8E10`/`E8E50`, `1EC820`, `ai_set_orders` and
campaign/runtime acceptance remain separate qualification work.
